text:
Ava - CS: Quick heads-up — Zephyr go-live is scheduled for next Tue. We need a lightweight customer-facing runbook for caching/batching/streaming handoff + a short renewal-risk note to send to the CSM. Can someone draft?
Diego (SE): I can draft the runbook checklist. Wants to confirm: are they using streaming for UI-only ops or for long-poll background tasks too?
Ava - CS: Mostly UI streaming (progressive hinting) + a background batch for nightly analytics. Renewal risk: they asked about warm pools and token spend forecasts.
Maya - Solutions: Ok. I'll add a short prefill/warmup plan and a sample telemetry snippet customers can paste. Keep it <=1 page.
Ethan - PM: We should include a quick fallback policy recommendation: when streaming fails, fallback to short-response batch with cached prefixes. That helped Acme.
Diego (SE): Draft checklist idea (short bullets):
- Confirm model + seq_len profile
- Enable client prefix cache (if repeat prompts)
- Warm 1-2 GPUs to 30% QPS 48h before go-live
- Setup streaming with 200ms heartbeat and 5s idle timeout
- Configure batcher with max_batch_size=8, max_wait_ms=50 for UI
- Nightly analytics: batch inference window at 03:00 with 32 concurrency
Maya - Solutions: Also add an ops snippet for customers to measure health metrics: 95p latency, cost per 1k tokens, and cache hit rate.
Ava - CS: Perfect. Can we embed a tiny config snippet they can copy? Short and tested.
Diego (SE): Sure — example client config (customer-facing):
```
# client config (copy into SDK)
cache: {enabled: true, ttl_ms: 60000}
batching: {max_batch_size: 8, max_wait_ms: 50}
streaming: {enabled: true, heartbeat_ms: 200, idle_timeout_ms: 5000}
warmup: {concurrency: 2, duration_min: 30}
```
Maya - Solutions: Add a note: "If cost is a concern, drop max_batch_size to 4 and enable quantized model variant for background jobs."
Ethan - PM: For renewal-risk blurb (1-2 sentences): "We recommend a 48–72 hour warmup window and an initial reserved capacity for predictable latency during ramp. We'll share token spend forecasts and a short checklist to minimize surprises during activation."
Ava - CS: Love it. Ops-bot, can you create a short template doc with those bullets and give a share link to the customer? Tag it Zephyr-go-live.
ops-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.docs/zephyr-go-live-runbook (private until shared) :white_check_mark:
Maya - Solutions: I'll craft the customer-facing 1-pager and send to Ava for sign-off by EOD.
Diego (SE): Quick addendum for troubleshooting: common failure modes + mitigations:
- Low cache hit rate -> increase prefix window, add semantic keys
- Streaming stalls -> increase heartbeat_ms to 500 for flaky networks; fallback to batch path after 2 failed frames
- Burst errors due to cold start -> pre-warm with synthetic traffic 6h prior
Ava - CS: Great. After sign-off, we'll ping the AE and include the renewal-risk blurb in the pre-go-live email. Thanks all :rocket:
